title: The manifest over the tracked tree: membership both ways, bytes, the detached hash, its own schema
note: MF1-MF7 remove, one at a time, what keeps final_manifest.json a provenance record: tracked-but-unlisted, listed-but-untracked, the sha256 and size of each entry, the detached hash, a field no generator writes, and the sorted order.

mutations.name: MF1_a_tracked_file_may_be_unlisted
mutations.find:
for f in sorted(tracked - listed):
        problems.append(f"tracked but not listed: {f}")
mutations.replace:
for f in ():
        problems.append(f"tracked but not listed: {f}")
mutations.rationale: a file added after the manifest was written is never recorded, the 30-file gap again

mutations.name: MF2_a_listed_file_may_be_untracked
mutations.find:
for f in sorted(listed - tracked):
        problems.append(f"listed but not tracked: {f}")
mutations.replace:
for f in ():
        problems.append(f"listed but not tracked: {f}")
mutations.rationale: a manifest names a file the repository does not carry

mutations.name: MF3_changed_bytes_pass
mutations.rationale: a file whose bytes changed still matches its recorded hash

mutations.name: MF4_the_detached_hash_is_not_compared
mutations.rationale: a rewritten manifest is not seen through its detached hash

mutations.name: MF5_unwritten_fields_are_accepted
mutations.find:
if extra:
        problems.append(f"fields no generator writes: {extra}")
mutations.replace:
if False:
        problems.append(f"fields no generator writes: {extra}")
mutations.rationale: a narrative field nothing re-derives rides along in the provenance record

mutations.name: MF6_the_order_is_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a reordered list passes, so a regeneration is no longer a reviewable diff

mutations.name: MF7_the_generator_does_not_sort
mutations.find: return sorted(f for f in out.splitlines() if f and f not in DETACHED)
mutations.replace: return [f for f in out.splitlines() if f and f not in DETACHED][::-1]
mutations.rationale: the generator writes an order its own check and its documentation say it does not
